l06-soupe-poisson-marocaine.t: Moroccan Fish Soup with Shrimp and Konjac Vermicelli
s: Sauté the garlic, chopped celery and spices in the oil for 4 min; add the grated tomato and let it cook down for 5 min.
Pour in 1.2 l of water and half the cilantro, bring to a boil and simmer for 15 min.
Add the whiting in large pieces and the rinsed konjac vermicelli; cook for 5 min.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 more min, without letting it boil hard.
Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and the rest of the cilantro; serve piping hot.
l06-soupe-poisson-marocaine.p: Add a spoonful of chermoula to each bowl just before serving for extra punch.

s: Steam the cauliflower for 10 min, then mash it and squeeze it in a kitchen towel to remove as much water as possible.
Mix with the eggs, cheese, almond flour, parsley, crushed garlic, spices and salt.
With wet hands, shape 12 small thick patties, 1.5 cm thick.
Brown them for 3 min on each side in hot oil over medium heat, then drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with a harissa-mayonnaise sauce or a chlada.
l06-maakouda-chou-fleur.p: Street-food maakouda is made with potato: squeezing the cauliflower dry is the key to getting the patties to hold together.

l06-courgettes-mchermla.t: Sautéed Zucchini Mchermla with Garlic and Cumin
s: Cut the zucchini into 5 cm sticks.
Sauté them for 8 min over high heat in the oil until golden but still firm.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and salt; continue for 3 min over medium heat.
Off the heat, add the chopped herbs and lemon juice; serve warm or cold.
l06-courgettes-mchermla.p: Excellent as a cold starter, like other Moroccan cooked salads; keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

l07-pizza-fathead-poulet-poivrons.t: Fathead Pizza with Chicken and Bell Peppers
i: cream cheese such as Kiri or Philadelphia
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, melt 170 g of mozzarella with the cream cheese in the microwave for 1 min, stir, then 30 s more until smooth.
Add the almond flour, egg and a pinch of salt; quickly knead with a spatula, then by hand, until you have a uniform ball.
Roll the dough between two sheets of parchment paper into a 30 cm disc (3–4 mm thick). Prick it with a fork.
Pre-bake for 10 to 12 min until the dough is golden.
Spread the crushed tomatoes seasoned with oregano and salt, then scatter the chicken, peppers, olives and remaining mozzarella.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for another 10 to 12 min until the cheese bubbles.
Let rest for 3 min before cutting into 8 slices.
l07-pizza-fathead-poulet-poivrons.p: If the dough stiffens while kneading, put it back in the microwave for 15 s. Pre-baked crusts freeze very well.

l07-pizza-fathead-margherita-thon.t: Fathead Pizza with Tuna, Olives and Basil
i: cans of tuna in water, drained
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Melt the shredded mozzarella and cream cheese in the microwave (1 min + 30 s), stir, then mix in the almond flour and egg until you have a smooth dough.
Roll out between two sheets of parchment paper into a thin 30 cm disc, prick it and pre-bake for 10–12 min at 200 °C.
Mix the crushed tomatoes with the grated garlic, half the oil and a pinch of salt; spread over the base.
Flake the tuna, add the halved olives and the sliced mozzarella.
Bake for 10 min, until the mozzarella has melted.
Out of the oven, scatter with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.
l07-pizza-fathead-margherita-thon.p: Drain the fresh mozzarella well and press it in paper towels to avoid a soggy pizza.

s: Finely chop the onion, garlic and celery.
In a deep skillet, heat 1 tbsp of oil and sauté the onion and celery for 5 min over medium heat.
Add the ground beef and garlic, break it up with a spatula and brown for 6–7 min over high heat.
Stir in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, thyme, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer for 20 min over low heat.
Meanwhile, cut the zucchini into spaghetti with a spiralizer (or into tagliatelle with a peeler).
Sauté the zucchini noodles for 2–3 min in the remaining oil over high heat, just to soften them without releasing water. Salt at the end.
Serve the sauce over the zucchini noodles, topped with Parmesan and basil.
l07-courgettis-bolognaise.p: The sauce freezes for 3 months in portions. Only salt the zucchini noodles just before serving so they stay crisp.

l07-carbonara-dinde-fumee.t: Halal Carbonara with Smoked Turkey and Konjac
i: packs of konjac spaghetti (200 g drained)
s: Rinse the konjac spaghetti thoroughly, boil for 2 min, then drain and dry for 3 min in a dry skillet over high heat.
In a bowl, whisk the yolks, whole egg, Parmesan and crushed pepper.
Brown the smoked turkey strips in the butter for 4 min over medium heat.
Add the konjac to the skillet and toss for 1 min to coat.
Remove the skillet from the heat, wait 30 s, then pour in the egg-Parmesan mixture, stirring briskly: the sauce should turn creamy without scrambling the eggs.
If it is too thick, add 1 to 2 tbsp of hot water. Serve immediately with parsley and pepper.
l07-carbonara-dinde-fumee.p: The secret: off the heat! The residual heat is enough to thicken the eggs.

s: Flatten the cutlets between two sheets of plastic wrap to 1 cm thick. Season with salt and pepper, then dredge in almond flour.
Heat the oil and 15 g of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the cutlets for 3–4 min per side until golden and cooked through. Keep warm.
In the same skillet, sauté the chopped garlic for 30 s.
Deglaze with the broth and lemon juice, scraping up the browned bits; reduce by half, 4–5 min.
Off the heat, whisk in the remaining butter in pieces to bind the sauce, then add the chopped pickles.
Return the cutlets to the sauce for 1 min, sprinkle with parsley and serve with green beans or cauliflower mash.
l07-piccata-poulet-citron.p: Traditional capers can be found in specialty grocery stores; chopped pickles give a close and accessible result.

l07-saltimbocca-dinde.t: Turkey Saltimbocca with Sage and Smoked Turkey
s: Lightly flatten the cutlets and season with pepper (no salt: the smoked turkey is already salty).
On each cutlet, place a pinch of sage, a slice of mozzarella, then 2 slices of smoked turkey; secure with a toothpick.
Heat the oil and half the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear smoked-turkey side down for 2 min, then flip and cook for 3–4 min.
Remove the meat, deglaze with the broth and lemon, and reduce for 3 min.
Finish the sauce with the remaining butter off the heat and spoon over the saltimbocca.
Serve with sautéed garlic spinach.
l07-saltimbocca-dinde.p: Remove the toothpicks before serving to children.

l07-lasagnes-courgettes-ricotta.t: Zucchini Lasagna with Ricotta and Spinach
s: Cut the zucchini lengthwise into thin slices (3 mm). Salt them, let them drain for 15 min on paper towels, then pat dry thoroughly.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Brown the beef with the garlic in the oil for 6 min, add the tomatoes and oregano, and reduce for 10 min: the sauce should be thick.
Wilt the spinach in a skillet for 2 min, squeeze out the water and chop.
Mix the ricotta, egg, spinach, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
In a 20 × 30 cm dish, alternate layers of zucchini slices, meat sauce and ricotta cream. Make 3 layers.
Cover with shredded mozzarella and bake for 35–40 min. Let rest for 10 min before cutting.
l07-lasagnes-courgettes-ricotta.p: Draining the zucchini is essential to avoid a lasagna swimming in water.

s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Flatten the cutlets to 1.5 cm.
Mix the almond flour, half the Parmesan, the paprika, salt and pepper on a plate.
Dip each cutlet in the beaten egg, then in the almond crumbs, pressing well.
Brown them for 2 min per side in hot oil, then arrange in a baking dish.
Top each cutlet with crushed tomatoes seasoned with oregano, then sliced mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan.
Bake for 15 min until fully cooked (74 °C at the center) and the cheese is golden. Sprinkle with basil.
l07-poulet-parmigiana.p: Almond crumbs burn quickly: keep the heat at medium for browning.

l07-salade-caprese-poulet.t: Caprese Salad with Grilled Chicken and Pesto
i: cider vinegar (or balsamic or wine vinegar)
s: Season the fillets with salt and pepper and grill them for 5–6 min per side in a grill pan with a drizzle of oil. Rest for 5 min, then slice.
Quick pesto: blend the basil, garlic, almonds, Parmesan and 2 tbsp of oil with a pinch of salt.
Slice the tomato and mozzarella into rounds.
Arrange the arugula, alternate tomato and mozzarella, and add the sliced chicken.
Spoon over the pesto, drizzle with vinegar and the remaining oil, and season with pepper.
l07-salade-caprese-poulet.p: The pesto keeps for 4 days in the fridge covered with a film of oil.

l07-riz-chou-fleur-cantonais.t: Cantonese Cauliflower Fried Rice with Shrimp and Eggs
i: green beans, cut into pieces (or a small amount of peas)
s: Grate the cauliflower (or pulse it in a food processor) until you have rice-sized grains.
In a hot wok with 1 tsp of oil, make a thin omelette with the beaten eggs, roll it up and cut it into strips.
Stir-fry the shrimp for 2 min with the chopped garlic, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil and sauté the smoked turkey and green beans for 3 min.
Add the cauliflower rice and stir-fry for 5 min over high heat, stirring constantly: it should stay slightly crunchy.
Return the shrimp and omelette, add the soy sauce, season with pepper, mix for 1 min and sprinkle with scallions.
l07-riz-chou-fleur-cantonais.p: Cauliflower rice can be prepared in advance and frozen raw in 300 g bags.

l07-curry-thai-vert-poulet.t: Thai Green Chicken Curry with Coconut Milk
s: Homemade curry paste: blend the cilantro, chilies, ginger, garlic, lime zest and 2 tbsp of coconut milk.
In a deep skillet, heat the coconut oil and fry the paste for 2 min over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 min.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, the soy sauce and the green beans; simmer for 8 min.
Add the zucchini in half-moons and cook for 5 more min.
Adjust with the lime juice and salt, and add the basil off the heat. Serve with cauliflower rice.
l07-curry-thai-vert-poulet.p: Adjust the chilies for the children: remove the seeds for a mild curry.

s: Cut the eggplant into cubes and the pepper into strips.
Sauté the garlic, ginger, tomato paste and spices in the coconut oil for 2 min.
Add the eggplant and brown for 5 min, stirring.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the pepper, season with salt and simmer for 8 min until the eggplant is soft and tender.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3–4 min, just until they turn pink.
Squeeze over the lime juice and sprinkle with basil.
l07-curry-thai-rouge-crevettes.p: Do not overcook the shrimp: they become rubbery after 4 min.

l07-bibimbap-keto.t: Keto Bibimbap with Beef and Cauliflower Rice
s: Stir-fry the cauliflower rice for 5 min in 1 tbsp of oil, salt lightly and divide among 4 bowls.
Brown the beef with the garlic and 2 tbsp of soy sauce for 6 min over high heat.
Wilt the spinach for 1 min with a drop of soy sauce; sauté the sliced mushrooms for 4 min.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into fine julienne.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up in the remaining oil, with runny yolks.
Arrange the beef, spinach, mushrooms, carrot and cucumber in sections over the rice; place the egg in the center.
Mix the harissa with 1 tbsp of soy sauce and 1 tbsp of water, spoon over, and sprinkle with sesame. Mix everything together when you are ready to eat.
l07-bibimbap-keto.p: For a "crispy bowl" effect, serve in cast-iron bowls heated in the oven.

l07-pad-thai-konjac.t: Konjac Pad Thai with Chicken and Peanuts
i: packs of konjac noodles (200 g drained)
s: Rinse the konjac noodles, blanch for 2 min, drain, then dry for 3 min in a dry skillet.
Sauce: mix the soy sauce, tomato paste, erythritol, lime juice and chili.
In the wok with the oil, sear the chicken for 4 min over high heat.
Push the chicken to the side, crack in the eggs and scramble them quickly.
Add the konjac, cabbage and sauce; stir-fry for 2 min to coat well.
Serve with crushed peanuts, scallions, cilantro and a lime wedge.
l07-pad-thai-konjac.p: Drying the konjac well in the skillet is the key to getting it to absorb the sauce.

s: Mix the soy sauce, erythritol, vinegar, grated garlic and ginger with 3 tbsp of water.
Heat the oil in a large skillet and place the thighs skin side down. Cook for 8–10 min over medium heat without touching, until the skin is crisp.
Flip and cook for 5 min. Remove the excess fat.
Pour in the sauce and reduce for 3–4 min, basting the chicken until glazed.
Steam the broccoli for 5 min.
Slice the chicken, spoon over the sauce, sprinkle with sesame and scallion. Serve with the broccoli.
l07-poulet-teriyaki-sesame.p: Add 1/4 tsp of psyllium to the sauce if you want it to be more clingy.

s: Halve the onion and ginger and char them for 5 min in a dry skillet.
Add them to the broth with the whole spices and the soy sauce; simmer for 20 min, then strain.
Rinse and blanch the konjac noodles for 2 min, then divide among 4 large bowls.
Arrange the raw beef slices over the noodles.
Pour the boiling broth directly over the meat: it cooks instantly.
Garnish with scallions, cilantro, mint, chili, halved hard-boiled eggs and lime.
l07-soupe-pho-boeuf-konjac.p: The broth must be truly boiling when served in order to cook the beef.

l07-saumon-gingembre-bok.t: Ginger-Soy Glazed Salmon with Stir-Fried Cabbage
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix 2 tbsp of soy sauce, the ginger, garlic and erythritol.
Place the fillets in a dish, brush with the glaze and bake for 12–14 min.
Meanwhile, stir-fry the shredded cabbage in the oil over high heat for 6–7 min; it should stay crisp.
Season the cabbage with the remaining soy sauce and a squeeze of lime.
Serve the salmon over the cabbage, sprinkled with sesame.
l07-saumon-gingembre-bok.p: For a more caramelized glaze, broil for 2 min at the end of cooking.

l07-larb-poulet-laitue.t: Thai Chicken Larb in Lettuce Cups
s: Heat the oil in a skillet and cook the ground chicken for 6–8 min, breaking it up, without drying it out.
Off the heat, add the lime juice, soy sauce and chili.
Stir in the very thinly sliced red onion and the chopped mint and cilantro.
Crush the peanuts.
Serve in lettuce leaves, sprinkled with peanuts.
l07-larb-poulet-laitue.p: Larb is eaten warm or cold: perfect for a lunchbox, with the leaves packed separately.

l07-palak-halloumi.t: Palak with Spinach and Grilled Halloumi
s: Blanch the spinach for 1 min in boiling water, plunge into ice water, drain and blend into a coarse purée.
Cut the halloumi into 2 cm cubes and brown in a dry non-stick skillet for 2 min per side. Set aside.
In a deep skillet, sauté the chopped onion in the ghee for 5 min, then add the garlic, ginger, chili and spices for 1 min.
Add the spinach purée, salt lightly and simmer for 5 min.
Stir in the crème fraîche and lemon, then the halloumi cubes. Warm through for 2 min.
Serve immediately, while the halloumi is still tender.
l07-palak-halloumi.p: Since halloumi is salty, taste before salting the sauce.

s: Sauté the chopped onion in the oil for 5 min, add the garlic and ginger for 1 min.
Add the beef and brown for 6 min, breaking it up.
Sprinkle in the spices, stir for 1 min, then add the tomatoes and 100 ml of water.
Add the cauliflower florets, cover and simmer for 12 min.
Stir in the spinach until wilted (2 min), and salt.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve with plain yogurt.
l07-keema-boeuf-petits-legumes.p: Keeps for 4 days in the fridge and freezes very well.

s: Cut the fish into large pieces and rub with turmeric and salt.
Heat the coconut oil, let the mustard seeds pop for 30 s, then add the sliced onion for 5 min.
Add the garlic, ginger, slit chili and remaining spices, then the diced tomato; cook for 3 min.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer for 5 min.
Gently add the fish, cover and poach for 6–8 min without stirring.
Squeeze over the lemon and sprinkle with cilantro.
l07-poisson-curry-coco-kerala.p: Shake the pot rather than stirring to keep the fish pieces whole.

s: Brown the beef in the oil for 6 min, breaking it up.
Add the spices, tomato paste, 80 ml of water and salt; reduce for 5 min until juicy but without excess liquid.
Pico de gallo: mix the tomato, finely chopped red onion, cilantro, half the lime juice and salt.
Dice the avocado and toss with the remaining lime juice.
Everyone fills their own lettuce leaves: meat, pico, avocado, cheddar and a spoonful of crème fraîche.
l07-tacos-laitue-boeuf.p: Double up the lettuce leaves so they hold better in your hand.

s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the zucchini into thin strips with a mandoline, salt, let drain for 10 min, then pat dry.
Sauce: sauté the garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes, spices, chili and salt; simmer for 8 min.
Mix the chicken with the cream cheese, half the sauce and half the cheddar.
Lay out 3 overlapping zucchini strips, top with 2 tbsp of filling and roll up. Arrange in a baking dish.
Cover with the remaining sauce and cheddar.
Bake for 20–25 min until golden and bubbling. Sprinkle with cilantro.
l07-enchiladas-courgette-poulet.p: Ideal for using up leftover roast chicken.

l07-crevettes-ail-mexicaines.t: Garlic Shrimp al Mojo de Ajo with Slaw
s: Slaw: finely shred the red cabbage, toss with the mayonnaise, the juice of one lime, the cumin and salt. Chill.
Thinly slice the garlic. Gently brown it in the oil for 3 min over low heat, without burning it.
Turn up the heat, add the shrimp and chili, and sear for 2 min per side.
Squeeze over the juice of the second lime, salt and add the chopped cilantro.
Serve the shrimp coated in their garlic oil, with the slaw.
l07-crevettes-ail-mexicaines.p: The garlic should turn pale golden, not brown, otherwise it becomes bitter.

l07-shawarma-poulet-bowl.t: Chicken Shawarma Bowl with Toum and Crunchy Vegetables
i: shawarma spices: cumin, paprika, cinnamon, turmeric, cardamom
s: Marinate the chicken for 1 h with the spices, 1 lemon, 2 tbsp of oil, 1 clove of grated garlic and salt.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Spread the chicken on a baking sheet and roast for 18–20 min until golden at the edges.
Quick toum sauce: mix the yogurt, mayonnaise, 2 cloves of grated garlic, the rest of the lemon and salt.
Slice the chicken into thin strips, like off a spit.
In bowls, arrange the cabbage, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, pickles and parsley, then the chicken.
Spoon plenty of toum over the top and drizzle with the remaining oil.
l07-shawarma-poulet-bowl.p: Fry the strips for 2 min in a very hot skillet for a crisp "spit-roasted" effect.

l07-kofta-agneau-tahini.t: Grilled Lamb Kofta with Tahini Sauce
s: Very finely chop the parsley and mint. Mix with the lamb, squeezed onion, 1 clove of garlic, the spices and salt; knead for 2 min.
Shape into 12 elongated sausages around skewers, wetting your hands to smooth them. Refrigerate for 15 min.
Sauce: whisk the tahini with the lemon, the remaining garlic, salt and 4–5 tbsp of cold water until creamy.
Grill the kofta on the barbecue or in an oiled grill pan for 10–12 min, turning them.
Serve with diced cucumber and tomato, drizzled with the tahini sauce.
l07-kofta-agneau-tahini.p: The tahini sauce first thickens with the lemon, then loosens with the water: keep whisking.

s: Pulse the raw cauliflower in a food processor into fine grains like couscous.
Wash and thoroughly dry the parsley and mint, then chop very finely with a knife.
Cut the tomato into small dice and slice the scallions.
Mix all the ingredients with the lemon, oil, spices and salt.
Let rest for 15 min in the fridge before serving.
l07-taboule-chou-fleur.p: A true tabbouleh is mostly parsley: don't skimp! Serve with lettuce leaves to eat it by hand.

l07-kofte-salade-berger.t: Pan-Fried Turkish Köfte with Shepherd's Salad
s: Mix the beef, egg, almond flour, squeezed grated onion, spices, half the parsley and salt. Knead for 3 min.
Shape into 16 small, flattened oval patties.
Cook them in a lightly oiled skillet for 4–5 min per side over medium-high heat.
Shepherd's salad: dice the cucumber, tomato and pepper, and dress with lemon, oil, parsley and salt.
Serve the köfte with the salad and the garlic yogurt.
l07-kofte-salade-berger.p: Kneading for a long time makes the köfte firm and juicy.

s: Preheat the oven to 220 °C.
Melt the mozzarella in the microwave (1 min + 30 s), mix with the almond flour and egg, divide into 4 and roll out 4 thin oval flatbreads on parchment paper.
Pre-bake for 6 min.
Topping: blend the pepper, onion, half the parsley, the tomato paste and spices, then mix with the raw meat and salt.
Spread the meat thinly over the whole surface of the flatbreads, right to the edges.
Bake for 10–12 min, until the meat is cooked and the edges are crisp.
Serve with arugula, parsley and a squeeze of lemon, rolled up or flat.
l07-lahmacun-keto.p: The meat layer must be very thin so that it cooks at the same time as the dough.

s: Marinate the chicken for 30 min with 2 tbsp of oil, the lemon, 2 cloves of garlic, the oregano, salt and pepper.
Tzatziki: grate the cucumber, salt it and squeeze hard in a kitchen towel. Mix with the yogurt, the remaining garlic, the dill and 1 tbsp of oil.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Grill for 12–15 min on a plancha or grill, turning regularly.
Serve with the tzatziki, sliced red onion and cherry tomatoes.
l07-souvlaki-poulet-tzatziki.p: Really squeeze the cucumber: a watery tzatziki is the classic pitfall.

l07-salade-grecque-complete.t: Complete Greek Salad with Tuna and Eggs
i: can of tuna in oil, drained
s: Boil the eggs for 9 min, cool them and peel.
Cut the tomato and cucumber into large chunks, and the pepper and red onion into thin slices.
Arrange the vegetables, olives and flaked tuna in two shallow bowls.
Add the quartered eggs and place the feta as a block on top.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar, sprinkle with oregano, and salt lightly.
l07-salade-grecque-complete.p: Feta is salty: only salt the tomatoes.

l07-gambas-saganaki.t: Shrimp Saganaki with Tomato and Feta
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
In an ovenproof skillet, soften the sliced onion in the oil for 4 min, add the garlic for 1 min.
Pour in the tomatoes, oregano and chili; simmer for 8 min.
Stir in the spinach, then arrange the shrimp in the sauce.
Crumble the feta over the top and bake for 8–10 min.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve piping hot.
l07-gambas-saganaki.p: Serve with cauliflower mash for dipping in the sauce.

l07-keftedes-feta-menthe.t: Greek Keftedes with Feta and Mint
s: Mix the meat, feta, egg, almond flour, chopped mint, squeezed onion and spices (little salt: the feta is salty).
Shape 20 walnut-sized meatballs and flatten them slightly.
Brown them in the oil for 3–4 min per side over medium heat.
Squeeze lemon juice over them at the end of cooking.
Serve over arugula with the Greek yogurt.
l07-keftedes-feta-menthe.p: Cold keftedes are perfect for picnics or lunchboxes.

s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter a 24 cm pan.
Thinly slice the leeks and soften them in the butter for 8 min over low heat, without browning.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spread the leeks, diced salmon and dill in the pan, pour over the egg mixture and sprinkle with Emmental.
Bake for 30–35 min: the center should be just set and slightly wobbly.
Let cool for 10 min before unmolding into slices.
l07-quiche-sans-pate-poireaux-saumon.p: Delicious cold: keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator, perfect for lunchboxes.

l07-quiche-lorraine-dinde-fumee.t: Crustless Quiche Lorraine with Smoked Turkey
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Butter a round cake pan.
Sauté the sliced onion and turkey strips for 5 min in the remaining butter.
Whisk the eggs, crème fraîche, almond milk, nutmeg and pepper (little salt: the turkey is salty).
Spread the strips in the pan, pour over the egg mixture and sprinkle with Emmental.
Bake for 30–35 min until puffed and golden.
Serve warm with a green salad with mustard vinaigrette.
l07-quiche-lorraine-dinde-fumee.p: For individual quiches, use muffin tins: 20 min baking time.

s: Salt the thighs and brown them skin side down in the oil for 8 min, then 3 min on the other side. Set aside.
Sauté the onion, sliced peppers and smoked turkey for 8 min.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, chili pepper and thyme.
Return the thighs skin side up, cover and simmer for 25 min.
Uncover for the last 5 minutes to reduce the sauce. Serve with cauliflower rice.
l07-poulet-basquaise.p: Espelette pepper can be replaced with sweet paprika and a pinch of chili.

s: Steam the cauliflower florets for 12 min, then blend with 20 g of butter, the Parmesan and salt until smooth.
Take the steaks out 20 min ahead, salt them and press the crushed pepper onto both sides.
Sear them in 10 g of very hot butter for 2–3 min per side for rare to medium. Rest under aluminum foil.
Deglaze the skillet with the broth, add the cream and mustard, and reduce for 3 min until it coats a spoon.
Finish with the remaining butter and pour over the steaks, with the mash alongside.
l07-steak-sauce-poivre-chou-fleur.p: Let the meat rest for 3 min: it will be juicier.

l07-soupe-champignons-gratinee-boeuf.t: Gratinéed Mushroom Soup with Shredded Beef
s: Slice the onion and mushrooms.
Soften the onion in the butter for 10 min over low heat until lightly caramelized, then add the mushrooms and brown for 8 min.
Pour in the broth and thyme, add the shredded beef and simmer for 10 min. Stir in the crème fraîche, season with salt and pepper.
Divide among ovenproof bowls and top generously with Emmental.
Broil for 4–5 min until the cheese is golden and bubbling.
l07-soupe-champignons-gratinee-boeuf.p: A great soup for using up leftover pot-au-feu or beef bourguignon.

s: Preheat the oven to 150 °C. Separate the whites from the yolks. Mix the yolks with the cream cheese.
Beat the whites to stiff peaks with a pinch of salt and the baking powder, then gently fold in the yolk mixture.
Shape 4 discs on parchment paper and bake for 18–20 min until golden. Let cool.
Raise the oven to 200 °C (broil). Spread 2 breads with mustard, top with turkey and half the Emmental, and close.
Cover the top with crème fraîche and the remaining Emmental.
Broil for 5 min until the cheese is melted and golden.
l07-croque-monsieur-keto.p: Add a fried egg on top for a croque-madame.

l07-ratatouille-oeufs-cocotte.t: Ratatouille with Baked Eggs and Feta
s: Cut the eggplant, zucchini and pepper into 2 cm dice.
In a large deep skillet, brown the eggplant in 2 tbsp of oil for 6 min, then add the zucchini, pepper and onion with the remaining oil; cook for 8 min.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, herbs and salt. Cover and simmer for 20 min over low heat.
Make 8 wells in the ratatouille and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 6–8 min, until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Crumble the feta over the top, sprinkle with basil and serve in the skillet.
l07-ratatouille-oeufs-cocotte.p: The ratatouille on its own keeps for 4 days and freezes; add the eggs when reheating.

s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Rub a gratin dish with a halved clove of garlic, then butter it.
Peel the celeriac and cut into 3 mm slices with a mandoline.
Heat the cream with the crushed other half of the garlic clove, the nutmeg, salt and pepper; add the slices and simmer for 8 min.
Pour into the dish, press down and sprinkle with Emmental.
Bake for 40 min until the tip of a knife slides in without resistance and the top is golden.
l07-gratin-dauphinois-celeri.p: The ideal side dish for a roast or the pepper steak.

l07-puree-chou-fleur-ail-roti.t: Cauliflower Mash with Parmesan and Roasted Garlic
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Wrap the unpeeled garlic cloves in aluminum foil and roast for 25 min.
Meanwhile, steam the florets for 12–15 min until very tender. Drain well and let the steam evaporate for 2 min.
Squeeze the roasted garlic pulp out of the skins.
Blend the cauliflower, garlic, butter, cream cheese and Parmesan until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve sprinkled with chives.
l07-puree-chou-fleur-ail-roti.p: Well-drained cauliflower = a firm, not runny, mash.

l07-brochettes-halloumi-chermoula.t: Halloumi and Vegetable Skewers with Chermoula
s: Chermoula: blend the cilantro, garlic, spices, lemon and oil.
Cut the halloumi, zucchini and pepper into 2.5 cm cubes.
Thread onto skewers, alternating with the mushrooms, and brush with chermoula.
Grill for 8–10 min on a plancha or barbecue, turning, until the halloumi is golden.
Drizzle with the remaining chermoula before serving.
l07-brochettes-halloumi-chermoula.p: Halloumi doesn't melt: it's perfect on the barbecue.

s: In a large paella pan, brown the chicken in the oil for 6 min, add the squid for 2 min.
Add the sliced pepper, garlic and grated tomato; cook for 4 min.
Stir in the paprika, turmeric and cauliflower rice, mixing well to coat.
Pour in the broth, salt, and cook for 6 min without stirring.
Arrange the shrimp and mussels on top, cover and cook for 5–6 min until the mussels open (discard any that stay closed).
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.
l07-paella-chou-fleur-fruits-mer.p: Let the bottom stick slightly for 1 min over high heat at the end of cooking to get the "socarrat".

l07-gaspacho-avocat-crevettes.t: Green Avocado Gazpacho with Grilled Shrimp
s: Blend the cucumbers, avocados, pepper, garlic, cilantro, lemon, 2 tbsp of oil, the ice water, cumin and salt until velvety.
Chill for at least 30 min.
Sear the shrimp in the remaining oil for 2 min per side, and salt.
Serve the gazpacho well chilled in bowls, topped with the shrimp and a drizzle of oil.
l07-gaspacho-avocat-crevettes.p: Prepare it the same day: avocado oxidizes after 12 h.

s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter or oil a 24 cm pie dish.
Sauté the onion in the olive oil for 3 min over medium heat, add the spinach and let it wilt for 4–5 min, stirring.
Drain the spinach thoroughly in a colander, pressing with the back of a spoon to remove the water.
Beat the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, little salt (the feta is salty) and pepper.
Spread the spinach and crumbled feta in the dish, pour over the egg mixture and sprinkle with Emmental.
Bake for 30–35 min until the quiche is puffed, golden and a knife blade comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 min before cutting so the slices hold together well.
l08-quiche-sans-pate-epinards-feta.p: Keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator; reheat for 1 min in the microwave or eat cold in a lunchbox.

s: Cut the halloumi into 1 cm slices and pat dry with paper towels.
Cut the cucumber into half-moons, halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion.
Toss the vegetables with the olives, chopped mint, 1 tbsp of oil, lemon juice and pepper.
Heat a skillet or grill over high heat with a drizzle of oil and sear the halloumi for 2 min on each side until well browned.
Arrange the salad on plates, place the hot halloumi on top and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.
l08-halloumi-grille-salade-concombre-men.p: Serve the halloumi right away: it hardens as it cools. A squeeze of lemon juice just before serving makes it even better.

l08-curry-tofu-chou-fleur-coco.t: Tofu and Cauliflower Curry with Coconut Milk
s: Drain the tofu, press it for 10 min between two kitchen towels under a weight, then cut into 2 cm cubes.
Brown the cubes in 1 tbsp of coconut oil over high heat for 6–8 min, turning; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté the chopped onion for 3 min with the remaining oil, then the garlic and ginger for 1 min.
Add the spices and stir for 30 s to toast them, then pour in the coconut milk and salt.
Add the cauliflower, cover and simmer for 12 min over low heat until tender.
Return the tofu, add the spinach and cook for 2 min. Sprinkle with cilantro just before serving.
l08-curry-tofu-chou-fleur-coco.p: Serve with cauliflower rice. The curry is even better the next day: it keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the zucchini into 5 mm rounds.
Sauté them for 8 min over high heat in the oil with the chopped garlic and a pinch of salt so they release their water; drain.
Beat the eggs with the crème fraîche, Parmesan, herbs and pepper.
Arrange the zucchini in a gratin dish, pour over the egg mixture and top with rounds of goat cheese.
Bake for 25 min until the goat cheese is golden and the custard is set.
l08-gratin-courgettes-chevre.p: Don't skip the pre-cooking step: otherwise the zucchini release too much water and the gratin is runny.

l08-shakshuka-feta-poivrons.t: Shakshuka with Bell Peppers and Feta
s: Sauté the sliced onion and pepper strips in the oil for 8 min over medium heat.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika, stir for 1 min, then pour in the crushed tomatoes and salt.
Simmer uncovered for 8 min until the sauce thickens.
Make 6 wells with a spoon and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5–7 min over low heat until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Crumble the feta, sprinkle with cilantro and serve straight from the skillet.
l08-shakshuka-feta-poivrons.p: Add a touch of harissa with the tomatoes for a spicier version.

l08-galettes-courgette-feta.t: Zucchini Fritters with Feta and Dill
s: Grate the zucchini, salt lightly and let drain for 10 min in a colander.
Squeeze them very hard in a clean kitchen towel to remove as much water as possible.
Mix the zucchini with the eggs, crumbled feta, almond flour, Parmesan, dill and chopped scallions, and season with pepper.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and flatten into 8 cm fritters.
Cook for 3–4 min per side until well browned, then drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with the Greek yogurt mixed with a little chopped dill.
l08-galettes-courgette-feta.p: The fritters can be frozen cooked; reheat for 8 min in a 200 °C oven to restore the crispness.

i: can of tuna in oil, drained
s: Boil the eggs for 9 min, cool and peel.
Cook the green beans for 7 min in salted boiling water, then plunge into ice water to keep their color.
Make the vinaigrette by whisking the mustard, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper.
Arrange the lettuce, quartered tomato, thinly sliced pepper and green beans on a large platter.
Add the flaked tuna, quartered eggs and olives, then drizzle with the vinaigrette.
l08-salade-nicoise-thon.p: Add a few anchovy fillets or capers for an even more authentic version.

l08-tofu-saute-brocoli-sesame.t: Stir-Fried Tofu with Broccoli and Sesame
s: Press the tofu for 10 min in a kitchen towel, then cut into cubes.
Brown it in 1 tbsp of oil in a wok or skillet over high heat for 6–8 min; set aside.
Add the remaining oil and the broccoli in small florets, stir-fry for 3 min, then add 3 tbsp of water and cover for 3 min.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili, stir for 1 min.
Return the tofu, pour in the soy sauce mixed with the tahini and stir-fry for 1 min to coat.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame and sliced scallions before serving.
l08-tofu-saute-brocoli-sesame.p: For extra-crispy tofu, roll the cubes in 1 tsp of psyllium before browning them.

s: Preheat the broiler. Slice the mushrooms.
In a 24 cm ovenproof skillet, brown the mushrooms in the butter for 6–7 min over high heat, then add the garlic and spinach for 1 min.
Beat the eggs with the cream, chopped parsley, salt and pepper.
Pour over the vegetables, reduce the heat and cook for 6–8 min without stirring until the edges are set.
Crumble the goat cheese on top and broil for 3–4 min until the frittata is puffed and golden.
l08-frittata-champignons-chevre.p: Cut into squares, the cold frittata makes an excellent snack or packed lunch.

l08-aubergines-gratinees-mozzarella.t: Eggplant Gratin with Tomato and Mozzarella
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the eggplants lengthwise into 1 cm slices.
Brush with oil, salt and roast for 20 min on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Meanwhile, simmer the tomatoes with the chopped garlic, salt and pepper for 10 min.
Mix the ricotta, eggs, half the Parmesan and the chopped basil.
In a dish, layer tomato sauce, eggplant, ricotta mixture and sliced mozzarella; finish with the mozzarella and remaining Parmesan.
Lower the oven to 180 °C and bake for 20 min until the top is golden and bubbling.
Let rest for 10 min before serving so the layers hold together.
l08-aubergines-gratinees-mozzarella.p: Can be made the day before: assemble, cover and refrigerate, then add 10 min to the cooking time.
